crossRefs.note: It shall be, if you shall forget Yahweh your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify…
All of you stand today in the presence of Yahweh your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers…
I teach you today, even you, So that your trust may be in Yahweh.
Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying…
You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might…

I prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Lord Yahweh, don’t destroy your people and your inheritance that you have redeemed…
the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which…

translations.web: Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of Yahweh your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm,
translations.bsb: Know this day that it is not your children who have known and seen the discipline of the LORD your God: His greatness, His mighty hand, and His outstretched arm;
translations.kjv: And know ye this day: for I speak not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,
translations.asv: And know ye this day: for I speak not with your children that have not known, and that have not seen the chastisement of Jehovah your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his outstretched arm,
